items.title: Packers vs. Rams Start 'Em, Sit 'Em: Wednesday Night - Jordan Love, Christian Watson, Matthew Golden, Tucker Kraft, Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams, Blake Corum, Tyler Higbee, more
NFL DFS Lineup Picks for FanDuel, DraftKings - Packers vs. Rams Wednesday Night Showdown
Rashod Bateman (groin) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Bateman was hobbled after taking a hard hit in the Ravens’ Week 11 loss to the Panthers. He pops up on the injury report with a groin issue to start the week, though he was still limited in practice. Bateman is hardly fantasy relevant at this point, but an absence would indicate more Ja’Kobi Lane targets for Week 12 against the Texans. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Zay Flowers (ankle) was limited in Wednesday’s practice.
items.text: Flowers dealt with ankle issues earlier this season and now pops up on the injury report with a limited designation due to the ankle. He is still trending to play in Week 12, where he will operate as the Ravens’ WR1 for Jacoby Brissett against the Texans. Barring setbacks, the ankle should not limit Flowers too much as he sits in the WR2 rankings this week. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Rams declared QB Ty Simpson, DE Larrell Murchison, OLB Darryl Peterson III, C Coleman Shelton, G Steve Avila, and OLB Desjuan Johnson inactive for Week 12 against the Packers.
items.text: Simpson will operate as the team’s emergency third quarterback. Avila and Shelton were declared out heading into the day, leaving the Rams offensive line short-handed against a Packers defensive line getting Micah Parsons back. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Micah Parsons (knee) is active for Week 12 against the Rams.
items.text: Parsons is officially back after the Packers activated him off the PUP list this week. He is back nearly a year after suffering a torn ACL last season, making his debut on Thanksgiving eve against the Rams. The Packers pass rush gets a boost with the return of the five-time Pro Bowler this week. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Josh Jacobs (thumb) is inactive for Week 12 against the Rams.
items.text: Jacobs was limited in the Packers’ practices this week, but is not ready to return to play just yet. Kaleb Johnson and MarShawn Lloyd will split the backfield opportunities in his absence. The Packers also declared LB Zaire Franklin, OL Jager Burton, OL Donovan Jennings, and OL Mekhi Becton inactive for Week 12 against the Rams. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: NFL Insider Tom Pelissero reports Kyren Williams “has been battling turf toe for the past month.”
items.text: Williams was on the Rams’ injury report this week with a toe injury before getting cleared off the report before Wednesday. Pelissero reveals that Williams told him he has been battling turf toe for the past month. This stretch coincides with Blake Corum’s increased opportunities while Williams has seen his role reduced to more of a backfield split. Williams will continue to play through the injury, but expect Corum to still be heavily involved as a result. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is questionable for Week 12 against the Chiefs.
items.text: Kincaid was limited in practice all week but said he would most likely play. The Bills also listed Christian Benford (groin), T.J. Sanders (shoulder), O’Cyrus Torrence (ankle), and Dorian Williams (calf) as limited for Thursday night after a week of limited practices for each player. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Kyler Murray (hamstring) was limited in Wednesday’s walk-through.
items.text: Murray was listed as a limited participant for the Vikings’ walk-through practice. Since going down with a hamstring injury, Murray’s starting role has been taken over by Kirk Cousins. Even if Murray is good to go for Week 12, he is likely to be in the backup role to Cousins against the Falcons. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Tai Felton (hip) was limited in Wednesday’s walk-through.
items.text: Felton pops up on the injury report with a limited listing as he deals with a hip injury. The second-year wide receiver saw a team-high 12 targets in Week 11 against the 49ers and has seen increased opportunities with Jordan Addison still dealing with a thumb injury. Also limited was Myles Price (knee/groin). Both Price and Felton offer limited deep-league upside with Addison out. Felton is the receiver to roster, if you must. - Aditya Fuldeore

items.title: Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) did not practice Wednesday.
items.text: Darrisaw seemingly re-injured his shoulder in the Vikings’ Week 11 loss to the 49ers. Minnesota just held a walk-through, but the franchise left tackle starts out not practicing. He is truly questionable ahead of Week 12 against the Falcons. - Aditya Fuldeore
